models.queue: A list of active downloads currently being processed by the download client, showing real-time progress and speed.
models.history: A record of past download attempts, including completed, failed, and removed items with their final status.
models.alerts: System-level notifications regarding the status of download infrastructure and connectivity.

relationships: Queue items represent active 'Download' entities from the data model.
History items represent completed or failed 'Download' entities.
Each activity record links to a Movie or Episode via the title and quality metadata.
